relations.subject: Geshe Lhakdor
relations.object: Library of Tibetan Works and Archives
relations.evidence: In 2005, he became the Director of the Library of Tibetan Works and Archives in Dharamshala, India.

relations.subject: Geshe Lhakdor
relations.evidence: Geshe Lhakdor was conferred with an Honorary Professorship by the University of British Columbia, Vancouver, Canada in 2002

relations.subject: Geshe Lhakdor
relations.evidence: he attended the Central School for Tibetans in Dalhousie, India from 1972 to 1976.

relations.subject: Geshe Lhakdor
relations.evidence: In 1976, he joined Institute for Buddhist Dialectics in Dharamshala, India where he studied Buddhist Philosophy and successfully completed his Master of Prajnaparamita in 1982.

relations.subject: Geshe Lhakdor
relations.evidence: From 1986 to 1989, he worked as a translator and research assistant at the Tibet House in New Delhi.

relations.subject: Geshe Lhakdor
relations.evidence: In 1989, he received his Master of Philosophy from the University of Delhi.

relations.subject: Geshe Lhakdor
relations.evidence: And he completed his Geshe Degree from Drepung Loseling Monastic University in Karnataka State, South India.

relations.subject: Geshe Lhakdor
relations.evidence: He served as the translator and religious assistant of the Dalai Lama in 1989. While working as the Dalai Lama's assistant, he translated several books of the Dalai Lama
